description: Lists the email templates and, for each, the blocks_schema (JSON Schema for heading, body_md, cta_text, cta_url, image_url, image_alt and sections). Also returns email_themes with page theme ids; pass one as blocks.theme.theme_id to match its palette, local font stacks and email-safe shapes. Free and read only. Pick a template here before campaign_draft and fill only the blocks its schema accepts. Requires API key scope: read.
name: templates_list
title: List templates
